surah.personality_title: Surah An-Najm (The Descending Star & The Lote Tree of the Limit)
surah.personality_summary: Autonomous Qur'anic surah possessing a distinctive theological axis, spiritual atmosphere, and structural cadence.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah An-Najm (The Star) is the 53th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 62 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ وَالنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والنجم اذا هوى
ayahs.translation_saheeh: By the star when it descends
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: By the star when it sets

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Your companion [Muhammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Your companion has not strayed; he is not deluded

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: he does not speak from his own desire

ayahs.translation_saheeh: It is not but a revelation revealed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The Quran is nothing less than a revelation that is sent to him

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Taught to him by one intense in strength
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: It was taught to him by [an angel] with mighty powers

ayahs.translation_saheeh: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and great strength, who stood

ayahs.translation_saheeh: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: on the highest horizon

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then he approached and descended
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and then approached––coming down

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: until he was two bow-lengths away or even closer––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and revealed to God’s servant what He revealed

ayahs.translation_saheeh: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [The Prophet’s] own heart did not distort what he saw

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So will you dispute with him over what he saw
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Are you going to dispute with him what he saw with his own eyes

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And he certainly saw him in another descent
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: A second time he saw him

ayahs.translation_saheeh: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: by the lote tree beyond which none may pass

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Near it is the Garden of Refuge
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: near the Garden of Restfulness

ayahs.translation_saheeh: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when the tree was covered in nameless [splendour]

ayahs.translation_saheeh: The sight [of the Prophet] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: His sight never wavered, nor was it too bold

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَقَدۡ رَأَىٰ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ آيَاتِ رَبِّهِ الْكُبْرَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_clean: لقد راى من ايات ربه الكبرى
ayahs.translation_saheeh: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and he saw some of the greatest signs of his Lord

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So have you considered al-Lat and al-'Uzza
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [Disbelievers], consider al-Lat and al-Uzza

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And Manat, the third - the other one
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and the third one, Manat––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Is the male for you and for Him the female
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: are you to have the male and He the female

ayahs.translation_saheeh: That, then, is an unjust division
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: That would be a most unjust distribution!––

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّآ أَسۡمَآءࣱ سَمَّيۡتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلۡطَٰنٍۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهۡوَى ٱلۡأَنفُسُۖ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا أَسْمَاءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَا أَنْتُمْ وَآبَاؤُكُمْ مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ سُلْطَانٍ ۚ إِنْ يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى الْأَنْفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ مِنْ رَبِّهِمُ الْهُدَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان هي الا اسماء سميتموها انتم واباؤكم ما انزل الله بها من سلطان ۚ ان يتبعون الا الظن وما تهوى الانفس ۖ ولقد جاءهم من ربهم الهدى
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allah has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: these are nothing but names you have invented yourselves, you and your forefathers. God has sent no authority for them. These people merely follow guesswork and the whims of their souls, even though guidance has come to them from their Lord

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or is there for man whatever he wishes
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Is man to have everything he wishes for

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Rather, to Allah belongs the Hereafter and the first [life]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when the present life and the life to come belong only to God

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ۞وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكࣲ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغۡنِي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ أَن يَأۡذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرۡضَىٰٓ
ayahs.arabic_simple: ۞ وَكَمْ مِنْ مَلَكٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ لَا تُغْنِي شَفَاعَتُهُمْ شَيْئًا إِلَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ أَنْ يَأْذَنَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَرْضَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ۞ وكم من ملك في السماوات لا تغني شفاعتهم شيئا الا من بعد ان ياذن الله لمن يشاء ويرضى
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allah has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: There are many angels in heaven whose intercession will be of no use until God gives permission to those He will, whose words He will accept

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسۡمِيَةَ ٱلۡأُنثَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ الْمَلَائِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ الْأُنْثَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان الذين لا يؤمنون بالاخرة ليسمون الملائكة تسمية الانثى
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Those who deny the life to come give the angels female names

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغۡنِي مِنَ ٱلۡحَقِّ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا لَهُمْ بِهِ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا الظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ الظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ شَيْئًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما لهم به من علم ۖ ان يتبعون الا الظن ۖ وان الظن لا يغني من الحق شيئا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They have no knowledge to base this on: they merely follow guesswork. Guesswork is of no value against the Truth

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَأَعۡرِضۡ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكۡرِنَا وَلَمۡ يُرِدۡ إِلَّا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْ مَنْ تَوَلَّىٰ عَنْ ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا
ayahs.arabic_clean: فاعرض عن من تولى عن ذكرنا ولم يرد الا الحياة الدنيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So [Prophet] ignore those who turn away from Our revelation, who want only the life of this world

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ مَبۡلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_simple: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُمْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ ضَلَّ عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ اهْتَدَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ذلك مبلغهم من العلم ۚ ان ربك هو اعلم بمن ضل عن سبيله وهو اعلم بمن اهتدى
ayahs.translation_saheeh: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Their knowledge does not go beyond that. Your Lord knows best who strays from His path and who follows guidance

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ لِيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔواْ بِمَا عَمِلُواْ وَيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَى
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسَاءُوا بِمَا عَمِلُوا وَيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا بِالْحُسْنَى
ayahs.arabic_clean: ولله ما في السماوات وما في الارض ليجزي الذين اساءوا بما عملوا ويجزي الذين احسنوا بالحسنى
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Everything in the heavens and earth belongs to God. He will repay those who do evil according to their deeds, and reward, with what is best, those who do good

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِۚ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِكُمۡ إِذۡ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِذۡ أَنتُمۡ أَجِنَّةࣱ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡۖ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
ayahs.arabic_simple: الَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَائِرَ الْإِثْمِ وَالْفَوَاحِشَ إِلَّا اللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَاسِعُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنْشَأَكُمْ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنْتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ اتَّقَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_clean: الذين يجتنبون كبائر الاثم والفواحش الا اللمم ۚ ان ربك واسع المغفرة ۚ هو اعلم بكم اذ انشاكم من الارض واذ انتم اجنة في بطون امهاتكم ۖ فلا تزكوا انفسكم ۖ هو اعلم بمن اتقى
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: As for those who avoid grave sins and foul acts, though they may commit small sins, your Lord is ample in forgiveness. He has been aware of you from the time He produced you from the earth and from your hiding places in your mothers’ wombs, so do not assert your own goodness:He knows best who is mindful of Him

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Have you seen the one who turned away
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [Prophet], consider that man who turned away

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And gave a little and [then] refrained
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: he only gave a little and then he stopped

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Does he have knowledge of the Unseen? Can he see [the Hereafter]

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَمۡ لَمۡ يُنَبَّأۡ بِمَا فِي صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِي صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ام لم ينبا بما في صحف موسى
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Has he not been told what was written in the Scriptures of Moses

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and of Abraham, who fulfilled his duty

ayahs.translation_saheeh: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that no soul shall bear the burden of another

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَن لَّيۡسَ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَنْ لَيْسَ لِلْإِنْسَانِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وان ليس للانسان الا ما سعى
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that man will only have what he has worked towards

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And that his effort is going to be seen
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that his labour will be seen

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and that in the end he will be repaid in full for it

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And that to your Lord is the finality
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that the final goal is your Lord

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that it is He who makes people laugh and weep

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And that it is He who causes death and gives life
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that it is He who gives death and life

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that He Himself created the two sexes, male and female

ayahs.translation_saheeh: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: from an ejected drop of sperm

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the next creation
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that He will undertake the second Creation

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And that it is He who enriches and suffices
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that it is He who gives wealth and possessions

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that He is the Lord of Sirius

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And that He destroyed the first [people of] 'Aad
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that it was He who destroyed, in their entirety, ancient 'Ad

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And Thamud - and He did not spare [them]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and Thamud

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحࣲ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ هُمۡ أَظۡلَمَ وَأَطۡغَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِنْ قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وقوم نوح من قبل ۖ انهم كانوا هم اظلم واطغى
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and before them the people of Noah who were even more unjust and insolent

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the overturned towns He hurled down
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that it was He who brought down the ruined cities

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And covered them by that which He covered
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and enveloped them in the punishment He ordained for them

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which then of your Lord’s blessings do you deny

ayahs.translation_saheeh: This [Prophet] is a warner like the former warners
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: This is a warning just like the warnings sent in former times

ayahs.translation_saheeh: The Approaching Day has approached
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The imminent Hour draws near

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَيۡسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ليس لها من دون الله كاشفة
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Of it, [from those] besides Allah, there is no remover
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and only God can disclose it

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then at this statement do you wonder
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do you [people] marvel at this

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And you laugh and do not weep
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Why do you laugh instead of weeping

ayahs.translation_saheeh: While you are proudly sporting
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Why do you pay no heed

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So prostrate to Allah and worship [Him]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Bow down before God and worship
